snippet.title: Concrete Tremor - FULL PLAY + All Endings (UNSORTED HORROR)
snippet.description:
Immerse yourself in the chilling experience of Concrete Tremor, a captivating horror game featured in the "UNSORTED HORROR" collection. This compilation includes 5 short first-person horror games, each set in a sinister dystopian world of intricate machinery. With playtimes around 10-15 minutes per game, it's the perfect eerie adventure for a single session. Grab a metaphorical CD case, read its enigmatic backside, and venture forth on a suspenseful journey.

In this video. Concrete Tremor is a thrilling game that puts you in control of plastic explosives amidst the backdrop of iconic Soviet apartment buildings.

Timestamps:
00:00 - Intro
01:40 - Concrete Tremor
10:23 - Ending 1
11:21 - Ending 2

Want to experience the game yourself? UNSORTED HORROR is available for free download on itch.io: https://mikeklubnika.itch.io/unsorted-horror
Don't forget to check out our other indie game plays on our Youtube playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL-F0N8jK-1VycE00t9IWl1r2dKjhZ_bbt 

If you enjoyed this video, please hit the like button and consider subscribing to our channel. Every recommendation and share helps us out as a small indie channel. Be sure to hit the bell icon to be notified when we post new videos. Thank you for watching!
